purpose: Convert every verified implementation failure pattern into a permanent regression requirement.
maintenance_rule: Every newly verified meaningful failure must be corrected at its responsible layer and added here before it can be considered closed.
pass_condition: No regression case may violate its invariant. A visually attractive result is still a failure when the listed contract is broken.

cases.input: User locks 35mm. A reference analysis infers 50mm with high confidence.
Huge foreground hand, wide rectilinear view, straight architecture.
must_hold: scale exaggeration comes from camera proximity

cases.input: Environmental portrait where location must remain readable.
must_hold: large format or f/1.2 is not mandatory

cases.input: Bright clean commercial photograph.
Clean daylight image with a named film-stock reference.
must_hold: stock is not automatically warm/faded/heavily grained

cases.input: Pristine luxury product image that must look real.
must_hold: no random dirt/scratches/asymmetry/noise added as realism tokens

cases.input: Malformed hand with overly smooth skin.
Make this beauty portrait's skin look real without changing age or makeup.
Keep hairstyle tidy but realistic.
Reflective wet-night portrait with visible practical source.
Fix only waxy skin while preserving identity, pose, wardrobe, framing and background.
User asks to edit an image that is not actually available in the active host context.
must_hold: return handoff spec or request image only if essential

cases.input: Woman waiting for a taxi in London at night.
must_hold: AUTO completes without demanding camera/lens/aperture/stock/grade answers unless essential

cases.input: A=identity, B=product geometry, C=lighting/color.

cases.input: Analyze a reference with no reliable metadata.
must_hold: exact camera/lens/stock/aperture remain hypothesis/unknown rather than fact

cases.input: Same T0, same pose/gaze/hands/props; only camera changes.
Translate one resolved shot across Generic, OpenAI, Gemini, Seedream, FLUX, Magnific and Higgsfield.
must_hold: creative intent and locks remain invariant

must_hold: use current verified/live surface or generic fallback

must_hold: no image generation/edit execution regardless of tool availability
